title: Archery Tournament Chants (Phawar Iasiat Khnam)
cultural_context: Rhythmic chanting delivered by cheerers (pyrton) during traditional Khasi archery tournaments (Iasiat Khnam). Archery is the national sport and sacred martial art of the Khasi people.
lyrics_khasi:
Hoi kiw! Hoi kiw!
Ko pyrton ba shlur, khie mih sha madan,
Bat ïa ka ryntieh, pynwan ïa u khnam!
Sha u thong ngin thew, sha u thong ngin siat,
Ha ka burom u kpa, ha ka burom ka me!
Hoi kiw! Hoi kiw! Khie siat beit sha khlieh!

U khnam uba nep u la leit thaba,
U la dung ha ka skum ba la buh ha lyngkba!
Ko samla ka shnong to pyrta jam,
Namar ba u khnam u la jop ia ka nam!

U lum u them u la sawa kynjai,
Ka ryntieh siej-lieng ka la pynhiar kynhai!
U nongsiat ba tbit u la thoh la ka kti,
Ban kyntiew ia ka burom jong la ka Ri!

Ka wait ka stieh ngi kyntait noh,
Tang u khnam u ryntieh ngi bat thoh!
Ka jingsiat ka dei ka akor ka bor,
Kaba neh pateng la pateng ha ka dor!
lyrics_english:
Hoi kiw! Hoi kiw! (Victory cry!)
O valiant cheering clan, step forth onto the field,
Grip the bamboo bow, notch the feather-flighted arrow!
Straight at the circular target we aim, into the bullseye we release,
For the honor of our father, for the glory of our mother!
Hoi kiw! Hoi kiw! Let the arrow fly straight and true!

The sharp arrow has whistled through the mountain air,
Piercing dead-center into the straw cylinder in the clearing!
O youths of the village shout out with mighty roar,
For the arrow has captured victory and lasting renown!

The mountain crags and valleys echo with the cry,
The curved bamboo bow recoils with a singing snap!
The master marksman has steadied his steady hand,
To elevate the ancestral honor of our beloved Motherland!

We put aside the sword and the shield,
Bearing only the sacred bow and arrow in our grip!
Archery is discipline, courtesy, and inner strength,
Enduring generation after generation in high esteem!

stanzas.title: Ka Pyrton (The Team Assembly Call)
stanzas.khasi:
Ko pyrton ba shlur, khie mih sha madan,
Bat ïa ka ryntieh, pynwan ïa u khnam!
Sha u thong ngin thew, sha u thong ngin siat,
Ha ka burom u kpa, ha ka burom ka me!
stanzas.english: O valiant cheerers, step into the arena! Grip the bow, notch the arrow! Aim at the target for the glory of father and mother!

stanzas.title: Ka Jingdung ha ka Skum (The Bullseye Strike)
stanzas.khasi:
U khnam uba nep u la leit thaba,
U la dung ha ka skum ba la buh ha lyngkba!
Ko samla ka shnong to pyrta jam,
Namar ba u khnam u la jop ia ka nam!
stanzas.english: The razor arrow flew like lightning, piercing straight into the cylindrical straw target! Let the village cheer aloud for victory!

stanzas.title: Ka Akor ka Ryntieh (The Code of the Bow)
stanzas.khasi:
Ka wait ka stieh ngi kyntait noh,
Tang u khnam u ryntieh ngi bat thoh!
Ka jingsiat ka dei ka akor ka bor,
Kaba neh pateng la pateng ha ka dor!
stanzas.english: We set aside the war sword, holding only the sacred bow! Archery is dignity, moral conduct, and heritage passed down generations!

vocabulary.ryntieh: Indigenous recurved bow crafted from selected mountain bamboo (siej-lieng)
vocabulary.khnam: Slender arrow fletched with bird feathers and iron tip
vocabulary.thong: The archery target mark or winning score goal
vocabulary.skum: The small cylindrical straw-bundled target erected at the far end of the range
vocabulary.pyrton: Clan cheerers and rhymers chanting phawar to inspire marksmen
vocabulary.hoi kiw: Ancient Khasi communal victory cheer and proclamation of triumph
